h: Wike takes fresh swipe at Atiku: "I pray you never know him"
p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has made a new remark about former Vice President Atiku Abubakar, reportedly telling listeners he prays they never get to know him. The two have traded public criticism for years.
more: Wike has previously said Nigerians have rejected Atiku's 2027 bid.
Atiku's camp is yet to respond to this particular remark.
